common_assumptions: File and service state matches expectations without prior verification
Previous tool call succeeded before proceeding to dependent steps
Git working tree is clean before branch operations
External services (GCP, GitHub, Render) are reachable and authenticated
Initial problem framing is correct and does not need revisiting mid-chain
strength_patterns: Concrete verification loops: each significant mutation is followed by a status or log read to confirm the effect
Parallel multi-file exploration: related files are read in a single turn rather than sequentially gated on each result
Iterative test-driven refinement: failing test output is used to target the next edit rather than re-reading the whole module
weakness_patterns: Fixation on the same file across many steps without extracting new information (scraper.utils.ts read 11+ times in fd5c15db; format-gate-stop.sh read/edited repeatedly in fcc859da)
Single thinking block at chain start with no mid-chain re-evaluation, even when tool results contradict the initial framing
High assumption carry-through: errors from early tool calls are not propagated as uncertainty into later steps, leading to silent compounding of stale state
